# YeboID developer integration

Read https://docs.yeboid.com/ai-agents for executable setup instructions.
Read https://docs.yeboid.com/llms-full.txt for the combined plain-text guide.
Check https://docs.yeboid.com/security/release for actual public release status.

- https://docs.yeboid.com/getting-started
- https://docs.yeboid.com/register-app
- https://docs.yeboid.com/app-verification
- https://docs.yeboid.com/permissions
- https://docs.yeboid.com/web-sdk/
- https://docs.yeboid.com/node-sdk/
- https://docs.yeboid.com/flutter-sdk/
- https://docs.yeboid.com/troubleshooting

JavaScript packages: yeboid-web and yeboid-node. The init generator creates React + Node only.
CLI doctor/init require yeboid-node 3.0.0; check release status before relying on availability.
Defaults: openid profile offline_access. Phone, email, KYC and business permissions are opt-in.
Permissions must be registered, requested, consented and enforced. Refresh cannot add permissions.
openid identifies an account, not a KYC verification. kyc reads status; apps enforcing verification must check it.
Keep secrets out of browser code. Use access tokens for APIs, never ID tokens. Store only stable sub as yeboid_user_id.
Never fabricate successful auth or verification when an API fails. Humans complete KYC and consent.
